title: Oydagi krater farg'onalik olim nomi bilan atalgan

scenes.text: Oyda farg'onalik olim nomidagi krater bor.
scenes.keywords: moon surface craters close up zoom

scenes.text: Ahmad al-Farg'oniy IX asrda yashagan, Yevropada uni Alfraganus deb atashgan.
Uning astronomiya kitobi lotinchaga tarjima qilinib, asrlar davomida o'qilgan.
Oydagi Alfraganus krateri aynan shu olim nomi bilan atalgan.
scenes.keywords: full moon rising night sky timelapse

description: IX asrda yashagan astronom Ahmad al-Farg'oniy Yevropada Alfraganus nomi bilan tanilgan, uning astronomiya kitobi lotin tiliga tarjima qilingan va Oydagi Alfraganus krateri uning nomi bilan atalgan.
source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Al-Farghani (Latinised as Alfraganus; lunar crater Alfraganus named after him; astronomy compendium translated into Latin in the 12th century); https://arxiv.org/pdf/2603.28837 (crater Alfraganus 5.4S 19.0E, about 20 km, named after Al-Farghani of Fergana); https://muslimheritage.com/people/scholars/al-farghani-alfraganus/.
